question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f843bce57eaf55140beeae4c1c7bb8526bf47e5c095accab522026a767efff.png]
solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97bbbd7431d8f916cc777344187768540e362e0323deb6e27bed520e4a09ac8a.png] 

The pattern followed in the image series is shown below:

1) Square shift towards the middle of the figure in second figure.

2) Star shift towards the right bottom corner in the second figure. 

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/386ceec15286cb508238bc2971e8004505dc017d620bbf6d8b36f162b674f9a6.png] shift towards the middle of the figure in the third figure.

4) Square shift towards the right bottom corner in the third figure.

5) Triangle shift towards the middle of the figure in fourth figure.

6) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/386ceec15286cb508238bc2971e8004505dc017d620bbf6d8b36f162b674f9a6.png] shift towards the right bottom corner in fourth figure. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/927767f1751a5b736bfb9a436b64da1a4b89077b9f3301339cea027f8b86824d.png] 

Hence, '**option 3**' is the correct answer.
